About CDC Vouchers

Every Singaporean household can claim CDC Vouchers to use at participating hawkers, heartland merchants and supermarkets.

How to claim

Claim your household's vouchers digitally using your Singpass. One member claims on behalf of the household.

  • Visit the official voucher website.
  • Log in with Singpass.
  • Share the voucher link with family members.

Where to spend

Vouchers are split between heartland merchants and hawkers, and participating supermarkets. Check the merchant list before visiting.
